build_mrfr_head: build a Masked Region Feature Regression transformer head for multimodal pretraining with image region features
create_mrfr_forward: create a forward pass that computes MSE loss between predicted and target image region features
test_MRFR_class: test the MRFR class by passing sequence outputs and processed sample lists with region targets and masks
review_MRFR_init: review the MRFR __init__ to verify img_embedding_weight shape matches hidden_size and img_dim parameters
summarize_feat_regress: summarize the feat_regress module which applies Linear, GELU, and LayerNorm to regress hidden states
